de las cung zad log byas nas// rang gzhan phan 'dod ser sna dang*// phrag dog chags pa dor byas nas// sbyin dang ldan zhing khro ba dor// tshul ldan bde 'dod mtho ris te// 'dod sred bcad nas bsam gtan gyi// bde 'tshol gzugs dang gzugs med len// de yang sngar ltar ro myong nas// chags ldan dug gsum dbang gis 'khor// sems su shes nas khams gsum gyi// chags sogs mthong sgom gyis bcom nas// mya ngan 'das sred de thob pa// der gnas nyan rang zhes brjod do// zhes de mtha' dag rang rang gi srid zhi'i go 'phang la sred pa dang bcas pas de dag las kyang 'da' dgos par bstan pa ni/ srid dang zhi ba gnyis ka la// sred spangs 'dzag med dbang thob pa// rdo rje theg par gsungs pa yin// zhes so// bzhi pa ni/ dga' bzhi'i ngo bo go rim dang*// dbye ba 'dzag skyon bcing thabs dang*// phan yon rnam par dag pa dang*// rgyu 'bras lugs 'byung lugs ldog kun// rgyal bas bla med rgyud kun gsungs// de phyir las kyi phyag rgya bcing*// 'dir ni rgyas par ma bris so// zhes mtshon byed dpe'i dga' bzhi 'jig rten pa'i mtshan nyid can dang*/ mtshon bya don gyi dga' bzhi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi ngo bo dang*/ 'dzag pa ni dga' bral bzhi pa dang brtan pa na lhan skyes bzhi par 'char ba'i go rim dang*/ sprul pa longs spyod chos dang lhan cig skyes pa'i sku bzhir sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi rang bzhin dga' ba bzhi bzhir phye ba'i dbye ba dang*/ de kho na nyid bcu drug mngal skyes rnams kyi ni sgrib pa dang bcas pa yin te bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'dor ba'i phyir ro// sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni sgrib pa dang bral ba yin te bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'dzin pa nyid kyi phyir ro// zhes skyon yon dang*/ dbab dang bzung dang bzlog pa dang*// gnas su bskyal dang rtsa mig gdab// rlung bsre sbyor ba drug po bya// zhes bcing thabs dang*/

rgyu lugs 'byung dang 'bras bu lugs ldog la sogs pa'o// de ltar dga' ba bzhi la rim gyis bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung ba dang bde ba rnam par smin pa dang yid kho nas ro myang bas rnam par nyed pa rang rtog pa'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig bzhi 'byung bas/ sna tshogs dang ni rnam smin dang*// rnam nyed de bzhin mtshan nyid bral// ces gsungs la/ mas brtan gyi tshe 'bras bu bzhir brjod de/ e wam̐ rnam par rgyu mthun nyid// rnam smin chos kyi 'khor lo la// longs spyod skyes bu byed pa nyid// bde ba'i 'khor lo dri med nyid// rgyu mthun sogs pas rab phye ba'i// 'bras bu rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod// ces gsungs so// des na dga' bral la nyams pa dang ma nyams pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa gnyis su 'gyur bas snga ma ni/ 'dod chags las ni sdig ste gang phyir shin tu sdug ma las kyang zhe sdang skye// zhes pa lta bu spyi'i nges pa dang phyi ma la khyad par gyi dga' ba'am dga' bral gyi dga' bar 'chad cing*/ rin chen rgyan 'drar/ dang po dga' ba/ gnyis pa mchog dga'/ gsum pa thig le nor bu'i rtser bzung ba lhan cig skyes dga'/ de la nā ro pa don gyi lhan skyes su bzhed/ mai tri pa dpe'i lhan skyes su bzhed/ bla ma lho pa'i zhal nas dbang po rab kyis don gyi lhan skyes su go /'bring gis dpe'i lhan skyes su go /mtha' mas dpe don gang du yang ma zin gsung*/ zhes gsungs so// dbang po'i rim pa de la dgongs nas nā ro pas dbang bzhi pa'i don lhan cig skyes dga' dang mai tri pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba la mdzad par grags shing dus kyi 'khor lor ni lhan skyes nyid la gnyis su phye nas zhu bde lhan skyes 'jig rten pa'i bzhi pa dbang dus nyid du dpe'i tshul mngon sum du rig nus la/ rang bzhin lhan skyes 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bzhi pa ni dbang dus su tshig tsam gyis mtshon nas phyis rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis mngon du byed par gsungs/

mdor na dbang bzhi pa'i don ni 'bras bu phyag chen yin la de nyid dpe dang don gyi cha shas nas rtogs par byed pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi chings so// bzhi pa tha mal gyi gnas skabs bshad pa la/ ngo bo bshad pa/ rnam dag bshad pa/ spang gnyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ tha mal dus kyi shes pa ni// kun gzhi nyon yid 'du byed kyis// sngar bshad rkyen bzhi nyer sbyor bas// mig sogs rnam shes drug po rnams// dbang po drug dang 'brel byas te// gzugs sogs yul drug rnams su snang*// bde drug btang snyoms tshor ba gsum// chags dang zhe sdang gti mug bskyed// de ma thag pa'i yid kyis khyer// kun gzhi'i steng bzhag yang 'du byed// ces dbang shes rnams yul la ches cher sad pa la brten nas yid kyi rnam par rtog pa skad cig kyang mi sdod par dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi las 'du byed pa'i gnas skabs te rnam shes rkyen bzhi las skye tshul le'u dang por bshad pa ltar ro// gnyis pa ni/ 'di nyid dag pa ye shes gsum// yid ni mig g.yo mnyam nyid de// kun rtog dag pa so sor rtog /sgo lnga'i yul rnams bya ba sgrub// ces nyon yid dag pa mnyam pa nyid/ drug yid dag pa so sor rtog pa/ sgo lnga'i shes pa dag pa bya sgrub ye shes te/gsum dang*/ kun gzhi dag ba me long*/ de bzhi'i rang bzhin chos dbyings ye shes te sangs rgyas kyi sa'i chos thams cad ni de lngas bsdus pa'o// gsum pa ni/ sgrib pa mthong spang sgom spang ste// gnyen po mos dang bdag med dang*// ting 'dzin snying rje rnam pa bzhi// des sbyangs sprul skus 'gro don mdzad// yid dang rmi lam gcig pa'i phyir// longs skur brjod de 'bras bu yin// rgyas par chos rnams thams cad du// gsungs phyir 'dir ni bsdus pa yin// de phyir chos kyi phyag rgya bcing*// zhes spang bya sgrib pa la dbye na bdag med mngon sum du mthong ba'i mod la spang ba dang mthong zin goms par bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis spang byar 'jog pa gnyis dang*/

gnyen po chos la/ mos pa sogs bzhi dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi'i 'khrul pa dag pa'i 'bras bu gnyid 'thug chos sku/ rmi lam longs sku/ sad pa sprul sku/ snyoms 'jug ye shes kyi sku yin la/ sangs rgyas ni gzhan don du sangs rgyas pa yin pas sku'i gtso bo sprul pa'i skus 'gro don mdzad do// chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ dpa' bo rdo rjes/ gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos po rnams la dang por dga' ba/ de la rtog pa ni mchog dga'/ yid skyo na dga' bral du 'gyur ro// de'i phyir gsal la mi rtog pa'i shes pa lhan cig skyes pa bsgom ste/ gang gang la ni sems bsdus nas// nang gi bdag nyid g.yo med par// gnas pa mig gi gzugs dag gam// zhes pa nas/ gnas pa yid kyi chos rnams la// bde chen shes na sgom pa'i mchog /ces bshad pa ltar ro// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni// gnas skabs bzhi dang 'khrul pa dang*// ma 'khrul ye shes lam rim dang*// phyag rgya bzhi dang sku bzhi ste// 'brel ba'i rten dang brten pa yin// zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las rnam shes dang ye shes gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'brel pa bstan pa ste drug pa'i 'grel pa'o/// /de nas phyi nang gcig tu sbyor ba'i phyir lus la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad tshang ba'i tshul bshad pa la/ bstan/ bshad/ bsdu gsum/ dang po ni/ de nas ji ltar nang gi lus// phyi rol ji bzhin gnas pa ni// khams gsum nang gi bdag nyid de// zhes thun mong gi theg par yang bdag 'bras yul du snang ba zhes phyi'i 'jig rten nang las kyi mthu las snang bar bstan pa dang*/ theg pa chen por ni chos thams cad sems kyi snang ba las gzhan du med par gsungs pas phug khru lnga par 'khor los bsgyur ba dpung dang bcas pa zhugs kyang dog pa'i snang ba med cing gzhan ngag la phug khru lnga par yang snang ba ltar 'jig rten gyi tshad dang bkod pa dus 'khor dang mngon pa nas bshad pa sogs mi mthun pa ji snyed kyang mi 'gal zhing*/

rnal 'byor ba'i lus la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gdags par nus zhes dang*/ khyad par sngags su/ rdo rje mi phyed ces byar brjod// sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa// zhes srid pa gsum po thams cad dag pa rdo rje gsum gcig tu sbyor ba ni dag sbyor zhes bya la/ de'i tshe phyi rol tu ri gling chu bo dkyil 'khor ni sku rdo rje/ dbugs nas lo bskal pa'i bar du dus sbyor bcu gnyis sam dus bzhi'i dbye bas yang yang 'khor ba'i dus kyi mtshan nyid can ni gsung rdo rje/ gza' skar 'ja' tshon glog dngas ma'i rlung dang nam mkha' rnams ni thugs rdo rje/ yang na sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i srid pa gsum mam khams gsum po sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum mo// de dag nang gi rdo rje gsum so so dang re re gang la'ang tshang bar 'jog pas dang po sku'i dbang du byas te lus khru bzhi dang 'jig rten gyi khams rlung dkyil gyi 'og nas srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi lta bu tshad kyi sgo nas sbyar ba dang gzhung du 'byung ba ltar dngos po mtshungs pa nyid kyis 'jog pa'o// gsung gi sgo nas nang gi dbyangs mtha' dag phyi rol gyi dngos po rnams la brjod byar 'brel ba'am khams mthun pas dang*/ de bzhin rten khu rdul rlung gsum dang brten pa bde gsal mi rtog pa tshogs pa gcig par gnas pa ni nang gi thugs rdo rje yin la sems de'i snang ba ma lus pa'ang khams bdag por gyur pa'i dbang gis snang ba yin pas phyi nang chos mthun zhing rten 'brel gyi 'gros gcig tu 'byung ba sogs shes dgos so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la don tshan dgu las dang po gnas gzhan nang la sbyar ba ni/ spyi bo nas ni sor bzhi po// gzugs med gnas te de 'og tu// sor ni bcu drug gzugs khams nyid// de 'og 'dod lha mir bcas pa// lte ba nas ni rkang mthil bar// lha min klu dang yi dgas dang*// dmyal ba brgyad kyi gnas rim gsungs// de ltar 'byung ba rim brtsegs nang la sbyar ba ni/

rkang lag tshigs gsum rim pa ltar// rlung me chu yi dkyil 'khor yin// brang ni sa ste/ zhes dang*/ ri bo rnams nang la sbyar ba ni/ sgal tshigs ni/ ri rab de bzhin ri bdun ni// brla dang rje ngar de 'og rus// dpung ba lag ngar lag pa dang*// sen mo'i bar du rim pa ltar// sngon po man+dha ra mtshan mo// nor bur byed dang bre bo dang*// kha ba can dang rdo rje'i ri// gling bdun gling po nang la sbyar ba ni/ gling drug nang na bad kan dang*// rgyu ma tshil snying mchin pa sha// zla ba dkar po ku sha dang*// mi'am ci dang khrung khrung gling*// drug po'i gling rnam rim pa ste// rkang lag dum bu bcug gcig ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling sogs gling bran bcas// 'byung ba lnga nang la sbyar ba ni/ sra ba brlan dang drod dang dbugs// khams bzhi bu ga nam mkha' yin// rgya mtsho bdun nang la sbyar ba ni/ khu ba zhag dang klad pa dang*/ bad kan 'o ma mchil ma rngul// dri chu nang gi rgya mtsho bdun// sbrang rtsi mar zho 'o ma chu// chang dang ba tsha'i rang bzhin no// gza' skar sogs nang la sbyar ba ni/ dbang po gza' dgu'i rang bzhin te// so ni rgyu skar rtsa chu'o// rgyu ma sprin dang nang gi rlung*// snying ga'i sgra ni thog yin te// lto ba'i sgra ni 'brug tu gsungs// me gsum nang la sbyar ba ni// snying ga mgrin pa lte ba na// glog dang nyi drod sreg byed me/ 'grel chen du/ 'dir lus la lha'i me dang khyim bdag gi me dang bsreg bya za ba'i me'o// zhes gsungs la/ snying ga'i mes zhe sdang bskyed/ mgrin pa'i mes zas skom gyi bya ba byed/ lte ba'i mes zas bsreg bzhu byed do// skye gnas dang dus sbyor sogs nang la sbyar ba ni/ gzhan yang pags pa drod dang spu// me dang rlung gi rang bzhin no// lus skyes srin bu skye gnas bzhi// char ni lce chung bdud rtsi ste// thun nas skad cig bar gyi ni// dus sbyor thams cad sngar bstan pa'i// rtsa rlung thig le sems bcas so// srog rlung dkar dmar sbyor ba ni// zla nyi 'dzin par snang ba dang*// de sogs rnam bshad du ma rnams// phyi nang gzhan gsum ye shes su// sbyor phyir dpag tu med pa gsungs// zhes phyi nang gi sgo nga dang mngal dang drod gsher dang rdzus skyes bzhi rlung me chu dang nam mkha'i khams su shes par bya'o// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/

de sogs rten 'brel rtogs pa na// thabs dang shes rab sbyor shes pas// sna tshogs yon tan 'gyur phyir ro// 'dir ni mdor bsdus cung zad brjod// zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las snod la sbyar ba bstan pa ste bdun pa'i 'grel pa'o/// /de nas le'u brgyad pa dang dgu pas gzhan lam dang 'bras bu'i chos nang gi lus sems la tshang bar ston pa las thog mar kun rtog gis brtags pa'i bskyed rim gyi gdags gzhi tshang ba'i tshul dang bskyed rim nyid sogs ston pa la/ bstan bshad/ bsdu gsum// dang po ni/ de nas sems can kun rtog la// kun brtags lha rnams sgom pa'i don// sems 'dzin phyi nang don shes dang*// dbang 'byor gzhan don gzugs ston phyir// dpa' bo gcig nas mtha' yas bar// gsungs pa'i nges pa 'di lta ste/ zhes las dang po pa rnams zhi gnas la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ lam du phyi'i dkyil 'khor dang nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i don shes pa dang*/ 'bras dus su snang ba la dbang 'byor bas gzhan don gzugs sku ston pa'i phyir/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa nas mtha' yas pa'i bar sgom pa'i nges pa ni 'di lta ste zhes mtshams sbyar ba'o// gnyis ba rgyas bshad la bzhi las/ dang po lha'i grangs kyi nges pa ni dus kyi 'khor lor rtsa dbu ma las lha thams cad 'byung ba'i rim pa gsum pa ltar/ dbu ma kun gzhi yang dag don// ye shes rlung dang thig le ni// dpa' bo gcig pa he ru ka'o// sku gnyis thabs dang shes rab dang*// steng 'og dkar dmar bden gnyis dang*// de sogs yab yum gnyis pa'o// lus ngag yid dang thig le rtsa// steng 'og bar gsum yi ge gsum// rlung gsum sogs phyir lha gsum ste// khams bzhi sogs ldan khyab bya bzhi/ ye shes lnga dang phung po lnga// 'khor lo rlung dang khyab byed bcas// lha lnga bstan te du mar gsungs// nam mkha' ye shes rnam shes drug /lha drug nyon yid dang bcas bdun// tshogs brgyad sogs phyi brgyad pa dang*// snying ga'i rtsa rlung sa bcu stobs// de sogs dgu dang bcu pa dang*// phung po khams bcu dbang po yul// drug drug de bzhin las byed pa// dbang drug dang bcas dkyil 'khor ni// lha lnga dgu dang bcu gsum dang*// nyer lnga so gnyis so bzhi pa// so bdun rigs brgya du ma'i bar/

rtsa rlung thig le 'khor lo'i grangs// rnam rtog grangs bzhin bstan pa ste// zhal dang phyag mtshan de dang mtshungs// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi nges pa ni/ rkang mthil rtsom byed rlung yin pa nas gsum mdo sa yin pa'i bar dang*/ sin+dhu rdo rje'i thig zlum po dang*/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhir mnyam pa dang*// g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab zur bzhi dang*/ steng 'og gi bu ga sgo bzhi dang*/ sna rtse bzhi rta babs yin pa sogs te/ lus la dkyil 'khor bshad ba ni/ phyi rol ji bzhin sa dang thig /dbyibs dang bcas pa bsdus pa ni// kho bos dkyil 'khor snang bar bshad// gsum pa thabs dang shes rab kyi rang bzhin bshad pa ni/ phan tshun thabs dang shes rab dang*// g.yas g.yon lus sems dkar dmar dang*/ rten dang brten pa ma lus pa// thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gsungs// de lta'i thabs shes su bzhag pa lnga po de dag lus bsam gyi sgo nas go ldog pa lnga dang bcur 'gyur la/ pha ma'i rgyud kyi khyad par bshad pa ni/ shes rab gtsor bstan shes rab rgyud// thabs gtsor bstan pa pha rgyud de// kun kyang gnyis med rang bzhin yin// zhes brjod bya thabs shes gtso che chung tsam ma gtogs gnyis ga zung 'jug ma bstan na rnal 'byor gyi sgra mi 'jug ste// rnal 'byor thabs kyi lus dang ni// shes rab gcig bu dag gis min// thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa// rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// zhes gsangs ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa ltar ro// gzhan yang yan lag gi sgo nas thabs shes kyi 'jog tshul ni/ mig ni thabs te gzugs shes rab// gzugs ni thabs gyur mig shes rab// ro ma thabs te rlung shes rab// rkyang ma shes rab rlung ni thabs// skyes bu thabs te sems shes rab// bud med shes rab sems ni thabs// dbus ni shes rab phyogs ni thabs// don dam thabs te kun rdzob ni// shes rab de bzhin bzlog pa'ang yin// de sogs dpag med shes par bya// kha dog yon tan rim pa rnams// rlung du ji skad bstan bzhin gsungs// bzhi pa bskyed rdzogs kyi nges pa ni/

dbyibs sku rlung dang brjod pa sngags// yid ni thig le rdzogs rim brjod// skye ba bskyed rim bstan pa ste// 'chi ba rdzogs rim nyid yin no// kun brtags bskyed rim shes bya ste// gzhan dbang 'brel pa rdzogs rim bshad// kun rdzob bden pa bskyed rim ste// don dam bden pa rdzogs rim bshad/ bden gnyis thabs rnams bskyed rim ste// dbyer med shes rab rdzogs rim gsungs// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de la sogs pa thams cad kyang*// phyi dang nang dang gzhan gyi rim// ye shes gcig tu sbyor ba ni// rtsa ba mdor bsdus brjod pa yin// ji ltar e wam̐ bshad pa bzhin// shes bya 'dzin med dang du sbyang*// zhes pas mdor na gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad e wam̐ gnyis su bsdus pa bzhin zung 'jug gi ye shes gcig tu 'du la/ ye shes de yang spros bral yin pas 'dzin med lhug pa'i ngang du sbyang bar bya'o// zab mo nang gi don rgyas par bshad pa las kun brtags kyi lha 'byung ba'i tshul bstan pa ste brgyad pa'i 'grel pa'o/// /dgu pa chos thams cad kyi sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed bstan pa la/ bstan/ bshad/ bsdu gsum/ dang po ni/ de nas chos rnams thams cad kyi// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed gsungs pa yi// nges pa 'dir ni bstan par bya// zhes gzhi bden gnyis zung 'jug la lam tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu bsags pas 'bras bu sku gnyis zung 'jug thob bo// de yang snang tshul kun rdzob ltar thabs bsod nams bsags pas shes rab kyi dbang po 'phel// shes rab des gnas tshul don dam dang mthun par ye shes kyi tshogs la mnyam par bzhag pas sgom byung gi shes rab skye zhing bsod nams kyang lhag par spel nus te/ dper na/ rmi lam du rmi lam rang bzhin med par shes pas sprul bsgyur nus pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ yang dag pa'i bden gnyis bshad pa/ de'i tshul ma rtogs pa'i log rtog spong ba/

rdo rje theg pa'i spang gnyen gyi rtsa ba bshad pa/ bye brag tu bla med rgyud kyi spang gnyen bshad pa/ de nyid rgyud kyi lha thams cad dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ sems can khams ni sangs rgyas kyi// snying po dri med bden gnyis ldan// zhes sems can gyi khams sam rang bzhin las gzhan du sangs rgyas med la 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi snying po rang ngo la dri ma med cing snang ba dang stong pa bden gnyis dbyer med du ldan pa glo bur gyi dri ma sbyang ba'i gzhi'o// bden pa gnyis ngos bzung ba ni/ 'di ni ye shes rdo rje ru// kun rdzob gzung 'dzin snang ba ste// bden pa chu zla lta bu'o// don dam stong nyid bco brgyad de// bden pa gnyis med ye shes brjod// ces ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa ltar kun rdzob ni gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba mtha' dag ste/ de la bden par 'jog pa ni rgyu rkyen tshogs na snang ba chu'i zla ba lta bu'i cha nas so// don dam ni snang ba mtha' dag rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa yin la bden par 'jog pa ni gzung 'dzin gnyis med rang rig ye shes kyi yul du gyur pas so// stong nyid de yang chos can gyi sgo nas rnam grangs bco brgyad du bsdus te/ gang phyir de yi rang bzhin de// yin phyir gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong*// zhes sogs so// zung 'jug gi don ni/ bden pa gnyis kyang phan tshun bltos pa'i brtags bzhag tsam las rang bzhin ma grub pas chu zla la snang stong gnyis mi 'gal ba ltar brjod kyang gcig tha dad ni gang du'ang mi brjod de/ gal te stong min cung zad yod// stong pa'ang cung zad yod par 'gyur// mi stong cung zad yod min na// stong pa yod par ga la 'gyur// zhes dang*/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las kyang bden gnyis mtshan nyid gcig na gzugs mthong bas kyang don dam mthong zhing de lta na 'bad med du grol bar 'gyur ba sogs skyon bzhi dang*/

tha dad na don dam mthong bas kun rdzob la mngon zhen mi bzlog cing de lta na myang ngan las 'da' mi nus pa sogs skyon bzhi bstan nas dung dang dung gi dkar po ltar mngon sum gyi yul rdzas su tha dad ma yin la/ dkar po nges kyang dung du ma nges pa 'byung ba ltar rtog pa'i yul go byar gcig ma yin par gsungs shing tshul gzhan yang chos thams cad rgyu rkyen la brten nas 'byung dgos pas rang bzhin skye ba med pa'i stong nyid dang*/ rang bzhin bden par yod na 'gyur du mi rung ba la rgyu rkyen rten 'brel las cir yang 'char ba zung 'jug ste/ 'phags pa klus/ brten nas skyes pa ma skyes par/ de nyid mkhyen pa mchog gis gsungs/ zhes dang*/ gang dag stong dang rten 'byung dag /dbu ma'i lam du ro gcig par// gsung mchog mtshungs pa med pa yi// sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// de lta'i bden gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad lha sngags bde chen gyi rang bzhin rnam dag ni rdo rje theg pa'i sbyang gzhi'o// sbyong byed ni/ de rtog byed pa'i rtog pas bskyed// gnyen po sbyong byed yin par bshad// sbyang gzhi'i grangs bzhin chos kun bstan// zhes kun rdzob kyi rnam par rtog pa la brten nas skyes pa'i don dam rtogs pa'i shes rab de yin pas bden gnyis thabs dang thabs byung du 'brel ba/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par// dam pa'i don ni bstan mi nus// dam pa'i don la ma brten par// mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur// zhes klu sgrub kyis gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa de'i tshul ma rtogs pa'i log rtog spong ba ni/ tshangs sogs grub mtha' thams cad kyang*// rnam rtog gis byas shes bya yin/ rgyu rkyen ldan dang med 'dzin sogs/ sna tshogs lta ba lus sems kyi/ gzung 'dzin la brten 'byung bar gsungs// zhes phyi rol pa la dbye sgo mang yang thams cad lus sems la brten pa'i 'khrul pas bdag tu smra bar mtshungs shing*/

rgyang 'phen pas shi nas bdag chad pas tshe phyi ma mi 'dod par tshe 'di'i grags pa dang longs spyod la chags nas rtsod pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos mang du byed/ gzhan rnams tshe phyi ma dang thar pa khas len yang thar pa'i go 'phang nor bas spang dgos so// phyi rol rdul phran phag na mo// kun gzhi yid bcas yul snang gi/ nus pa ma rtogs dbang gis te// 'on kyang bdag sogs byed pa po// dgag phyir rgyal bas gsungs pa yod// bdag dang gang zag btags par brjod// bden pa'i rdzas grub rdul tsam med// yod na 'bad med thar pa'am// thar med skyon 'gyur zhes su bstan// de sogs sems la snang ba yi// spang gnyen mkhas rnams kyis gsungs bzhin// zhes rang sde'i nyan thos gnas ma bu pas kyang gang zag gi bdag khas len cing*/ gzhan bye smra dang mdo sde pas phyi don rdul phran bden par 'dod pa dang*/ sems tsam pas shes pa bden par 'dod pa'i chos kyi bdag 'dzin rnams dbu ma pas rigs pa du mas bkag go /de ltar spang gnyen gyi chos nad kyi gnyen po'i sman ltar sna tshogs kyang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur gang 'gro nas nyams su blang bar bya'o// gsum pa rdo rje theg pa'i spang gnyen gyi rtsa ba bshad pa ni/ 'dir ni yul snang lus 'di la/ rtsa rlung thig le'i nges pa yi// spang gnyen de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// khyad par rdo rje'i lus ldan pa'i// skyes bu lo brgya'i rlung ji snyed// bsdoms na bye ba bdun cu bdun// sa ya bdun dang 'bum phrag drug /yod pas sbyang gzhi de sbyong ba'i// chos sgo de dang mnyam pa yin// brgyad khri bzhi stong rags rim grags// bzhi pa bye brag tu bla med rgyud kyi spang gnyen bshad pa ni/ de la ye shes rlung ji snyed// rgyu ba myang 'das lam ldan pa// gnyen po'i mchog ste bla med rgyud// de phyir lo brgya'i ye shes rlung*// bsdoms pas lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi// lo gsum zhag ni stong brgyad cu// lo gsum sku gsung thugs dbye bas// sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gsum ste// bgrod pa rigs drug rgyud du bshad// zla ba'i dbye ba'i rigs rnams ni// sum cu so drug rgyud du bshad// g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab kyi// dbye bas thabs dang shes rab rgyud// rtsa rgyud bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod// 'di ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ru// phyag grangs dag par gsungs pa yin// rlung de dag kyang ngag gi brjod pa ā li dang kā li thabs shes zung 'jug tu 'char bas de'i sgonas rgyas bshad ni/

a sogs dbyangs ni sum cu drug /ka sogs gsal byed de dang mnyam// rjod byed yi ge'i gtso bor gsungs// re re'ang rgyud phran sum cu ste// stong dang brgyad brgya yin par bshad// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yi// rgyud kyi yan lag ldan pa ste// thig le tsheg drag gri gug gi /dbye bas thung ring shin tu ring*// gsal byed sum cu dbyangs drug bsgyur// sum brgya drug cu rtsa ba'i dbyangs// nyin mtshan dbyangs kyang drug cu ste// de phyir dbugs grangs zhag gcig dang*/ lo gcig chu tshod dbyangs mthun phyir// gsal byed de dang mtshungs pa yin// zhib tu dbyangs 'char nang du ltos// bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi tshogs// rnam dbye bsdus par bstan pa yin// lnga pa de nyid rgyud kyi lha thams cad dang sbyar ba la/ ye shes kyi rlung la sbyar ba/ rtsa khams la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po la don tshan lnga yod pas thog mar dus 'khor kyi lha grangs ni/ da ni thabs shes gnyis med rgyud// de dag gtso bo cung zad brjod// lo gsum zhag la bdun gyis bgos// brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi ste dus 'khor nyung ngu'i lha grangs te// lhag gnyis thabs shes bdag nyid gsungs// 'khor lo sdom pa che chung gi lha grangs ni/ zla ba cha ni bco lnga ste// des phye bdun cu rtsa gnyis te// bdag po 'khrig bcas rnal 'byor ma'i// nges brjod rgyud kyi lha ru bshad// bsdus na dpa' mo sum cu bdun// thabs cig dang bcas lus la gnas// sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i lha grangs ni// zla phyed gsum gyi zhag de dag /khyad par thabs kyi rgyud yin pas// dus sbyor rgyu ba bcu gnyis kyi// dbye bas lnga brgya bzhi bcu yin// de la sgyu 'phrul dra ba ni// rnam gsum zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*// zhe lnga zhe gsum zung rnams so// nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa bzhi yin// gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha grangs ni// dpal ldan 'dus pa rnam drug ste// dgu dang bcu gsum bcu dgu dang*/

nyer lnga so gnyis so bzhi ste// thabs dang shes rab dbye ba yis// nyis brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi'o// thabs shes dang bcas grangs rnams so// rgyud gzhan las 'byung ba'i lha grangs thams cad 'di rnams su 'dus par bstan pa ni// thod pa rdo rje bdud rtsi dang*// dgyes rdor sogs rnams ma rgyud kyi// sdom pa'i nang du 'dus bar gsungs// gshin rje'i gshed sogs gsang bar bsdu// ngag dbang dus kyi 'khor lo sogs// dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor can// rnal 'byor rgyud kun kyang 'dus te// bya spyod de yi yan lag yin// de ni ye shes rlung bshad do// gnyis pa rtsa khams la sbyar ba la bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rtsa yang de bzhin gsungs pa ni// snying ga srog ni dus 'khor lo// ro rkyang zhabs kyi rang bzhin te// snying gar sangs rgyas lha mo brgyad// ye shes sna tshogs yum du brjod// bum pa bshang gci sha dang rkang*// khu khrag yin te gtsug gtor ni// nor bu gaṇ+ḍi shing dang dung*// phung po khams rnams sangs rgyas yum// mig sogs drug dang yul rnams ni// byang chub sems dpa' lha mor bcas// rkang sogs las dbang khro bo bcu/ lte ba'i rtsa rnams 'jigs ma sogs// gsung gi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin yin// tshigs chen bcu gnyis rtsa'i 'khor lo// sku yi dkyil 'khor gnas pa yin// sor tshigs klu dang gtum mo ste// ba spu 'byung po'i rang bzhin no// 'dod dang mi 'dod rtog pa kun// mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa// rtsa khams thabs dang shes rab kyi// dbye bas stong dang brgyad cu'o// gnyis pa ni/ dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa ni// rtsa gsum bdud bral bcas pa dang*// snying gar yum bzhi mchod pa bzhi// rtsa chen nyer bzhi rnal 'byor ma// rab gtum sogs yin de nang khams// thod pa'i dum sogs dpa' bor gsungs// khwa gdong la sogs khro bcur mtshungs// thim dang longs spyod bdag po'i phyir// lha ni bdun cu gnyis rang bzhin// 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab brgya nyi shu// lha ru rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsungs/

gsum pa ni/ dpal ldan 'dus pa bshad bya ba// phung po sangs rgyas lnga yin te// khams bzhi reg bcas lha mo lnga// mig gnyis sa yi snying po ste// rna ba phyag na rdo rje'o// sna ni nam mkha'i snying po ste// lce la bzhugs pa 'jig rten dbang*// yid ni 'jam dpal khams rnams la// sgrib sel yin te lus la ni// kun tu bzang po nyid ces bya// rtsa rgyus byams pa nyid yin no// yan lag tshigs dang kha gsang ba// khro bo bcu yi rang bzhin te// lte bar las kyi rigs skyes pa// mkhyen dang gtum sogs lha mo ni// drug cu rtsa bzhi gsungs pa yin// rdo rje dbyings sogs snying gar dgu// rdo rje'i rigs su gsungs pa ste// pad+ma'i sgron ma sogs bcu drug /mgrin par pad+ma'i rang bzhin la// spyi bor rab tu sang la sogs// 'khor lo'i rigs ldan sum cu gnyis// rgyas par rdo rje 'phreng bar gsungs// bzhi pa ni de sogs dkyil 'khor du ma rnams// rkyang pa phyogs re cha ldan pa// gsungs pa thams cad 'dir 'dus te// dper na dgyes rdor lha dgu ni// snying ga'i 'khor lo rkyang yin bzhin// thams cad lus kyi rtsa rlung yin// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni// mdor na rtsa ni sku yin te// rlung ni sngags dang yi ge'o// thig le phra mo'i rdzogs rim mo// de bzhin sbyin sreg las rnams kun// nang gi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed yin// 'dir ni phyogs tsam brjod pa'o// de bzhin sa dang lam dang gzungs// ting 'dzin rab 'byams lha dang sngags// lus sems snang ba'i dbye ba la// brten nas thams cad gzigs pas gsungs// zab mo nang gi don snang bar byed pa las chos kyi sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed bstan pa ste dgu pa'i 'grel pa'o/// /de nas sbyang gzhi bder gshegs snying po bden gnyis zung 'jug gdod ma nas dag pa de bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi sgo nas mngon du byas pas lam du 'gyur ba'i tshul gyi rim pa bshad pa la/

bstan/ bshad/ bsdu gsum/ dang po ni/ de ltar rtsa rlung thig le gsum// sems kyi cha las snang ba ste// de phyir 'di don gnad 'ching ba// lam rim kun las khyad par 'phags// zhes de ltar rtsa rlung thig le 'di dag gi don gyi gnad 'ching ba'i lam 'di lam rim gzhan kun las khyad par 'phags te/ de gsum sems las snang ba'i sems kyi rdzas yin la sems kyi ngo bo la 'khor 'das gnyis med kyang snang ba rtsa rlung thig le dag ma dag gi dbang gis gnyis su snang ba'i phyir// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la/ thun mong gi lam dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gnyis/ dang po la gsum las/ theg pa dman pa nyan thos kyi lam ni// gang zag bdag med zhi ba tsam// myur ba srid pa lan gsum ste// rgyun zhugs 'gor na'ang lan bdun yin// de ni rang don zhi ba tsam// gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi lam ni// rang rgyal bskal pa nyi shu nas// bse ru bskal pa brgya yis 'grub// de dag ni 'bras bu dman pas rgyu tshogs gsog la ches 'bad mi dgos pa'o// gsum pa theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam ni// sems can thams cad phan byed pa// byang chub sems dpa' grangs med gsum// 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni 'grub bar dka' bas de'i rgyur tshogs gsog gzhal du med pa dgos par bstan no// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i lam la// rgyud sde bzhi'i dus kyi khyad par bstan pa dang*/ bla med gyi lam dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'dir ni thabs kyi khyad par gyis// pha rol phyin pa'i lam de la// bya spyod tshul gyi thabs mkhas tsam// ldan yang mi tshe drug cu ste// rnal 'byor mi tshe bcu drug yin// bla na med pa tshe gcig gis// brtson ldan nges par 'grub par 'gyur// de yang thabs bde stong dbyer med kyi rtogs pa skyed byed smin lam dam tshig sdom pa dang bcas pa/ grol lam bogs 'don spyod pa dang bcas pa rnams yin la// de dag rgyu'i theg par ming tsam yang ma bstan cing 'dir ni thabs de dag gi byed las kyis lam myur ba dang bde bar bgrod nas 'bras bu yang chas mchog tu gyur pa'i rdo rje 'chang mngon du byed de/

dper na gser tsam du rigs mtshungs kyang sbyang ba'i khyad par gyis mchog dman snang ba ltar mdo sngags kyi 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas la'ang mchog dman yod par lung dang rigs pa du ma'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i dbang pos bka' bstsal to// gnyis pa bla med kyi lam dngos la// tshogs lam// sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mi slob lam ste lnga las/ dang po ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gtso bor gsog pa'i skabs yin pas/ dang por dbang thob bskyed rdzogs ni// legs shes mos sgrub tshogs lam ste/ zhes mdo'i tshogs lam/ chen por mchog gi sprul sku las gdams ngag nod du yod pa ltar 'dir mos gus kyi shugs drag pos zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang thob pa dang bskyed rdzogs mos pa yid byed kyi sgo nas sgrub pa'i skabs so// gnyis pa ni/ 'phags lam la dngos su sbyor bar byed pa'i lam ste rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad shes nas/ kun bzang spyod gnas drod thob nas// sbyor lam nyid la gnas pa yin// zhes rdzogs rim gyi nyams myong dpe'i ye shes rgyun chad med par skyong ba ni kun tu bzang bo'i spyod pa yin cing de la gnas pas drod thob pa ni sbyor lam mo// de la yang*/ 'jigs smyo de bzhin sdug bsngal dang*// mya ngan gdung bas 'tshe ba dang*// zhes de rnams zil gyis gnon nus pa drod chung ngu dang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ches// sgrub pa po nyid nyon mi mongs// zhes drod 'bring dang*/ phan dang gnod pa'i 'bras 'byung ba// zhes drod chen po thob pa'i tshad gsum mo// de dag ni mdo'i sbyor lam dang po gsum dang mtshungs la/ drod ma thob bar shin tu gsang ba'i tshul gyis ma bsgrubs na skyon du ma 'byung zhing thob nas lam myur du bgrod par bya ba'i bogs 'don du/ de tshe brtul zhugs spyod pa yis// sbyor lam bgrod nas mthong bar sbyor// zhes gsungs la/ brtul zhugs de la yang spros bcas phyi'i rkyen dang bsre ba phyag rgya dang po gsum la brten pa dang*/

spros med nang gi spyod pa phyag rgya chen mo kho nar brten pa gnyis las rang nyid gang la mos pa'i spyod pa la 'jug cing phyag rgya chen mo ni sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi yin pas// 'di ni so sor sdud pa dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi ldan lam yin te// rtsa ni sbyang ba zhes kyang bshad// bsam gtan yan lag rdzogs pa yis// mngon par shes pa lnga 'thob gsungs// sku yi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'o// zhes skabs 'di ni sor sdud rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting 'dzin bsgoms pas stong gzugs sna tshogs 'char zhing de dag la yang mi rtog par bskyangs pa na g.yo med bde ba'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi shes rab sogs yan lag bzhi ldan dang zag bcas kyi mngon shes lnga 'char la rtsa dbu ma sbyong ba'i lam yin pas sku rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa ni/ don dam chos nyid sngar ma mthong gsar du mthong ba'i lam yin la de thob tshul ni/ de nas srog rtsol sbyor ldan pas// mthong lam la ni sbyor bar byed// rtag tu 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis ni// rdo rje sems dpar yang dag 'jug /rlung gi rnal 'byor zhes bya'o// zhes ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar gzhug pa'i srog rtsol dang byang chub kyi sems ska sla mi 'pho ba'i 'dzin pa grub pa'i stobs kyis rdo rje sems dpa' don gyi ye shes skad cig gis mngon du byed/ 'phags lam gyi thog ma sa dang po thob/ de'i tshe rags lus las grol nas ye shes kyi sku 'ja' lus su 'gyur zhing 'di skabs gtso bor rlung gi rnal 'byor yin pas gsung rdo rje'i lam mo// gzhi pa la dngos dang*/ mthong sgom gyi rlung 'gag pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ mthong zin goms par bya ba'i phyir sgom pa'i lam ste/ spros med shin tu spros med kyis// rjes dran yan lag sbyang byas nas// ting 'dzin ye shes sbyor ba ni// phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis 'grub ste// gzhan don tshogs kyi spyod dang bcas// zhes spros med rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu dang shin tu spros med mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i spyod pa la brten nas gtum mo sbar bas byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bde ba rjes su dran pa thugs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang 'gyur med kyi bde ba thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yin la/

de dag ni bdud dang theg pa dman pa'i phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pas 'grub nas gzhan don phun tshogs tshogs spyod chen po la yang 'jug pa'o// sbyor ba yan lag drug dang sa lam sbyang tshul sems 'grel las dngos su ma gsungs kyang 'dir 'das ma 'das kyi lam gnyis yan lag drug tshar gcig gis bgrod pa'i tshul lam rkyang pa'i dbang du mdzad do// gnyis pa mthong sgom gyi rlung 'gag pa'i tshul ni/ dang po brgya phrag bco brgyad kyi// rlung dang rtog pa lhan cig dag /de ni 'jig rten pa yi lam// gnyis pa thig le lhan cig tu// gsang bar 'gags pa mthong ba'i lam// de yis ma rig skye shi 'gag /gsum par de nyid dag pa ste// lte bar de bzhin bzhi dang lnga// drug dang bdun pa snying ga ste// brgyad dang dgu pa mgrin pa la// bcu dang bcu gcig spyi bor bshad// ces rgyud 'grel du 'khor lo drug la sa gnyis gnyis sbyar yang 'dir gsang 'khor phyin du rlung dang rnam rtog rags pa stong brgyad brgya lhan cig 'gags shing dag pa tshogs sbyor mos spyod kyis/ de nas 'khor lo lngar thig le dang lhan cig pa'i rlung dang rnam rtog phra ba brgya phrag bco brgyad pa gnyis gnyis dag pa 'phags lam sa bcur bzhag pa'o// lnga pa ni/ lam gyi mthar thug pas de las gzhan du bslab par bya ba med pa ste/ de nas gtsug tor rlung 'gag pas// de tshe sangs rgyas 'thob par gsungs// zhes gtsug tor du dus sbyor bcu gnyis pa'i thig rlung sems gsum dag pa'i de ma thag tu sangs rgyas thob cing*/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gags pa dang*// mas brtan dga' ba bcu drug yin// stong dang snying rje dbyer med grub// lo gsum zla phyed gsum dag pas// ye shes sku nyid 'grub pa nyid// ces nang du rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dang de snyed kyi byang chub kyi sems g.yo med du bcings pas phyi rol tu'ang nyi zla la sogs pa'i 'phel 'grib dus kyi bgrod pa mtha' dag bcom nas 'chi med dus kyi 'khor lo phyi nang gzhan gsum ro gcig pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa yin la/

mas brtan du rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'gags/ dga' ba bcu drug thob cing stong nyid dang snying rje dbyer med bcu drug 'grub la sa de rnams bgrod pa'i yun ni dbu ma'i rlung dang mtshungs par lo gsum phyogs gsum yin no// dga' ba bcu drug ni phyi rol tu zla ba la dkar phyogs dang nag phyogs bcu drug gi dag pas phung po lnga khams lnga dbang po lnga 'gags pa'i dga' ba bco lnga/ bcu drug pa ni de thams cad kyi ye shes kyi cha rnams 'gags pa'i dga' ba dang*/ stong nyid bcu drug ni phyi stong pa nyid nas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi bar yin cing*/ snying rje bcu drug ni sems can la dmigs pa lnga/ chos la dmigs pa lnga/ dmigs pa med pa lnga/ bcu drug pa sangs rgyas kyi snying rje chen po rnams yin la dkar phyogs la dga' ba dang snying rje/ nag phyogs la stong pa nyid sbyar ro// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ rtsa rlung thig le rnam gsum gyi// sbyor drug mthar phyin 'bras bu yin// dbyer ba dpag med 'dir ma brjod// ye shes rim pa thams cad kyang*// snga ma'i sbyang gzhi dang mtshungs 'thob// ces mdor na rtsa rlung thig le gsum 'ching ba'i sbyor ba yan lag drug mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu yin cing lam gyi rnam gzhag dang rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi dbye ba dpag tu med kyang sngar bstan pa'i sbyang gzhi gnas skabs bzhi dang phung po lnga'i sgo nas sku bzhi ye shes lngar 'dus so// zab mo nang gi don snang bar byed pa bshad pa las lam dang rim pa sbyar ba ste bcu pa'i 'grel pa'o/// /de nas rdzogs rim 'od gsal gyi sbyang gzhi sdud rim ni gzhan du gsal zhing*/ gsum pa mjug gi don dum bu bcu gcig gi don bsdu ba sogs 'chad pa la/ sde snod gsum spyir bshad pa/ sde snod so so la sbyar ba/ sngags kyi tshul dang sbyar ba'i dgos pa/ 'bras bu'i tshul bsdu ba/

'di gang la rnyed pa/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las la gus par bstod pa/ bsngo ba dang bzod gsol te bdun las/ dang po ni/ rgyal bas rgyud rnams thams cad du// phyi rol thun mong snang ba dang*// nang du rtsa rlung thig le dang*// gzhan du kun brtags lha dang sngags// dri ma dang bcas rtog pa dang*// dri med ye shes rnam pa gnyis// thams cad don dam kun rdzob dang*// spros dang spros med gsungs pa la// zhes zab mo'i rgyud sde rnams ni rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod de de dag gi brjod bya ni de rnams su 'dus so// gnyis pa ni/ phyi rol byed po gzhan med pa// rten cing 'brel snang rang snang ste// rtog pas ldan min 'du byed kyi// snod bcud phra rags ming tshig dang*// yi ge phyogs dus la sogs pa// gsungs pa phyi rol mngon pa ste// zhes mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i skabs su phyi rol tu bdag dang dbang phyug sogs byed pa po med kyi snod bcud sogs mtha' dag sgyu ma ltar rten 'brel tsam gyi snang ba'i sgo nas bstan pa ltar/ ji ltar phyi bzhin nang na gnas// rtsa dang lus dbyibs 'jig rten la// rlung gis dag dus yi ge bskyed// thig le gza' dang rgyu skar dang*// chu bo me sogs nges pa bstan// zhes snod bcud 'khor 'das ma lus pa'i rtsa ba'am sa bon dang bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i rtsa rlung thig le'i phra gsang rnams bstan la/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi brjod bya lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa myur bar 'char ba'i thabs mkhas ldan tshul ni/ ji ltar mig btsum gzugs mi mthong*// phye bas snang bar 'gyur ba dang*// btsir na zla ba gnyis mthong ltar// sten gyi gnang 'ching ma shes pas// dbang byed ye shes mthong ba min// rten bcings lam gyi ye shes mthong*// phyi rol med kyang gzhan snang la// kun brtags lha dang dkyil 'khor ston// de phyir nang don mngon pa yin// de bzhin du phyi rol gyi mdo sder lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa sa lam gyi rim pa gsungs pa ltar nang lus kyi gnas nyer bzhi'i rtsa khams sa bcu dang*/

gzhan dkyil 'khor byang phyogs so bdun du bstan pa sogs ni nang gi mdo sder 'jog pas/ gzhan bshad lha dang dkyil 'khor yang*// sa dang lam dang pha rol phyin// gzungs dang sngags bcas byang chub phyogs// zad par zil gnod la sogs pa// bsgrub phyir zab dang rgya che'i phyir// mdo dang pha rol phyin par brjod// de bzhin du lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni sngags su tshogs gnyis kyi khar tshul khrims kyi tshogs zhes gsum du bstan nas lam gyi gtso bor mdzad pas 'dul ba'i sde snod du 'jog tshul ni/ phyi rol lus ngag bsrung sdom dang*// rang bzhin bcas ldan 'dul ba ni// nang du rang dang gzhan don la// ma rmongs thabs mkhas khyad par gyis// nyon mongs ye shes sgyur byed pa// de phyir nang gi 'dul bar gsungs// de yang pha rol tu phyin par// thabs chen rnams dang ldan pa la// nyon mongs byang chub yan lag 'gyur// zhes sogs gsungs pa yod mod/ de ni nyon mongs 'ga' zhig yul dus la bltos nas spang mi dgos pa tsam la dgongs shing 'dir lam gyi gnad dug gsum lhag par slong nas de nyid bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes su ldang tshul khyad par ba yod do// gsum pa ni/ 'dul dang mdo sde phyir shes pas// nyan rang 'bras bu thob byed de// zab mo'i mdo 'dul mngon pa rnams// spyod byed byang chub sems dpar 'gyur// thabs mkhas nang don rgyas par shes// sangs rgyas snying po'i tshul rtogs nas// 'bras bu rtogs pa lam byed pa// bla med sangs rgyas myur thob byed// ces thabs la mkhas pa nang don gyi sde snod 'dir ni 'khor ba'i rang bzhin de nyid myang 'das kyi 'bras bur ye bzhugs mngon du byed pas 'bras bu lam byed ces bya la/ de yang rang rgyud la gnyid snyoms sogs dri bcas kyi ye shes 'od gsal nam 'char ba'i skad cig de las ma yol bar gzhan rgyud lha dang bla ma'i ye shes dri bral du bsres pas skad cig ma gcig tsam la'ang grol ba grub pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyi byung ba ltar ro// bzhi pa ni/

thams cad ye shes rang bzhin te// de sgrib 'khrul rtog gzung 'dzin gyi// shes pa glo bur bar skyes nas// 'du byed mngon par 'du byas nas// yong pa ma mthong med pa mthong*// rnam rtog 'dam du bying gyur pas// byis pa 'khor ba'i nang du bying*// zhes shes rab kyis ye shes ma mthong bas 'khrul la 'khrul pa de bral tshul ni/ phyi nang gzhan gsum ye shes su// rtogs pas sangs rgyas rang bzhin te// kun rdzob gnyis su snang ba rnams// chu zla lta bur don du gzigs// don dam stong nyid bco brgyad po// dbyer med gcig tu bden gzigs pas// nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /sgrib gsum dang bral rang rig nyid// ji lta ji snyed ye shes gsungs// lnga pa ni/ de bas rdo rje theg pa ru// gsungs pa'i gnas lugs rtogs bya'i phyir// 'dir ni phyogs tsam bsdus pa yin// rgyas par bstan pa dpag med kyang*// rgyal sras rnams kyis bstan pa yi// rgyud 'grel rnams la lta bar gyis// rgyas bshad de rnams la 'jug par mi spro ba'am spro na'ang thog mar sgo 'byed la 'di dgos pas/ de rnams kun la 'jug pa'i sgo// zab mo nang gi don bshad pa// de yang chos la dbang za ba spangs nas/ 'di ni rang bzo ma yin te// thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das// rgyal bas gsungs pa kho na bris// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i rgyud sde rnams rdo rje'i tshig shin tu brling zhing mtha' drug gi dbus su chud pas go dka' ba ma yin nam zhe na/ de lta yin mod kyang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po mkhas rnams kyi// rnam 'grel mthu la rab brten nas// rdo rje theg pa'i nang gi don// phyin ci ma log rnyed pa yin// rdo rje theg pa zhes bya ba'i sgra don ni/ ye shes kun nas gcad du med// rdo rje zhes ni mngon par brjod// ces gsungs pa dang*/ theg pa ni gong nas gong du 'degs pa'i don gyis 'dis 'gro ba lam dang 'dir 'gro ba 'bras bu'i theg pa zhes bya'o// drug pa ni/

thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba 'di dag la brten nas 'bras bu'i rgyud rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang mngon du bya nus la de'i phrin las gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i yon tan ni 'di lta bu'i zhes mos pa dang don gnyer spro ba bskyed pa'i ched de/ rgyal ba nam mkha'i sku can ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun tu gzugs sku 'khor ba ji srid ston// zhes sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul ni rang don phun tshogs don dam gyi sku'i dbang du byas nas yul stong nyid nam mkha' ltar dag pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang yul can ji lta ji snyed mtha' dag mkhyen pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar gsal ba'i ngang las gzhan don phun tshogs kun rdzob kyi sku'i dbang du byas nas gzugs sku gnyis 'jig rten kun tu ston te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa/ ngo bo mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ 'khor sa thob pa la snang ba/ chos theg chen 'ba' zhig ston pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid bzhugs pa ste nges pa lnga dang ldan no// sprul pa'i sku ni de lta bu'i nges pa med par sna tshogs su 'char ba mchog gi sprul sku mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa dang*/ bzo sprul sku dang skye ba sprul sku gang la gang 'dul rgyun chad med par ston pa'o// gsung gi gsang ba ni/ lha yi rnga sgra lta bu'i gsung ni 'du mi mdzad par yang*/ nam mkha'i khams mnyam 'bad med 'gro ba kun gyis thos par mdzad// ces dang*/ thugs kyi gsang ba ni/ thugs ni yid bzhin nor ltar 'bad med ye shes lhan cig tu// spros pa mi mnga' spros ldan rnams la yid bzhin re ba skong*// zhes gsungs so// phrin las kyi gsang ba ni/ bya ba yul la yod pa'i phrin las sems can gyi khams de sbyong ba'i phyir byed pa po la yod pa'i phrin las sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa ni nyi ma'i 'od zer ltar 'jig rten du 'jug go

/tshul 'dis dus skad cig ma gcig tsam dang*/ yul sems can gcig tsam dang*/ spyod pa'am thabs 'di lta bu gcig gi sgo nas sems can gyi don mi mdzad bya ba med par shes bya la srid tshad kyis phrin las rnam par dkar ba'i bya ba byed nus shing sems can rnams kyi sgo gsum dang lhan cig bzhugs kyang khyod kyi sku gsung thugs la nyes tshogs kyis cung zad kyang mi gos pa 'di la nges shes 'khrungs zhes/ sems can nyon mongs lhan cig 'jug kyang khyod la gos pa med// de phyir rang byung rgyal ba khyod la bdag ni gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bdun pa ni/ 'di ltar zab mo'i nang gi don lkog gyur bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas gsal por bstan pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs kho na'i rgyu yin pas/ zab mo nang don bshad pa la/ dge ba'i mthu yang ci yod pas// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun// ye shes sku nyid thob par shog /ces gsungs la/ gzhung 'dir ma go ma rtogs bzhin du mkhas pa'i nga rgyal dang rlom pas brjod pa'i tshig med mod kyang gsang sngags kyi sgra go bder bcos pa dag la brten nas/ cung zad 'gal bar gyur srid na// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// zab mo nang gi don gsal bar byed pa'i rnam par bshad pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyung ba dum bu bcu gcig pa/ rang byung rdo rje'i ming can gyis bla na med pa'i rgyud 'grel ji lta bar nang gi don shes par 'dod pa rnams kyi don du bstan pa'o// rdzogs sa so/// /mkhas par rlom pa dang bsgoms nas nyams myong dang mngon shes shar bar 'dod pa kun gyis kyang phyogs re las ma go bar 'dug pas 'dir bsdus te bstan pa yin no// zhes gsungs shing*/ dben gnas bde chen steng du khyi lo zla ba bdun pa la mdzad pa'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog /lta ba bden gnyis zung 'jug la gnas shing*// sgom pa rtsa rlung thig le'i thabs kyis brgyan// spyod pa rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub byas na// 'bras bu rang la gnas pa'i ye shes mthong*// zhes bya ba ni bsdus pa'i don no// rgyal ba'i gsung ni rnam pa thams cad de// tshig 'bru gcig la'ang 'chad tshul zad pa med// brjod med brjod pa'i gsang ba bsam mi khyab// de phyir bdag ni brjod 'dod kho nar zad// 'on kyang cha tsam brjod la nyes gyur na// thugs brtser ldan pas ci nas bzod rigs shing*// gang la 'bad pa'i dge tshogs mchis so 'tshal// de ring nyid du 'gro bas thob gyur cig

/ces lhan cig gnas pa karma mchod sprin rgya mtshos gtsos pa du mar sman pa'i slad du zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa'i mtshan gyi byin brlabs can dkon mchog yan lag ces bya bas chos thun du bris pa sa ga'i nya rgyas la grub pa'o/// /oṃ swasti/ gdul bya'i blo gros dri med gsar pa la// rgyal ba'i yon tan bsam yas bkra bya'i phyir// chos kyi sbyin pa'i phyi mo par tshogs 'di// nang so mchod sprin rgya mtsho nyid dang ni// sa skyong sku rab sde pa khu dbon gyis// rgyu rkyen mtshungs par sbyar nas rab bsgrubs pa// rig pa'i 'byung gnas yul nas blo gsal rigs// karma tshe dbang zhes byas yi ger bkod// bsam grub chos dbang rig rgyal la sogs pa// bcu phrag gcig gis rnam par 'phrul te brkos// 'dir 'bad dge legs ma la yi ya rlung*// bde bar reg pas dub pa kun bsangs te// legs par spyad pa'i dri bsung gis gos shing*// dam pa'i lam la spro ba 'phel gyur ci// e ma chu bung lta bu'i sgo gsum po// thog med srid 'dir don med 'das mod kyang*// de ring snying po'i don la 'brel pa thob// rnam dkar sa bon gang 'di 'gro bar bsngo// gzhan yang phyogs 'dir 'brel thogs ji snyed dang*// chos spyod bcu yi tshul la 'bad pa kun// rtag tu bsam sbyor chos dang mthun 'gyur zhing*// 'di dang phyi ma'i don gnyis myur 'grub shog /gang zhig chos sku'i rten gyur zab mo ye shes tshogs kyi rtsa ba ni// yi ge'i lam nas thos bsam sgom pa rnam par spel bar gsungs pas na// tshul 'dis 'gro kun yid la yon tan mi zad chos kyi phyag rgya thebs// zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin thob srid zhi'i dpal 'byor kun la spyod par shog// /shu bha mastu sarba dza ga tāṃ/// /
